node.title: A cubic quotient-block tail alone cannot pay C36' energy
node.statement: For every official order n=2^s with 22<=s<=41, an explicit abstract quotient-block profile satisfies the exact mass sum_B m_B(m_B-1)=(n-1)(n-2) and the cubic tail #{B:m_B>=tau}<=4n^2/tau^3, yet its induced clean energy (n-1)^2+sum_B m_B(m_B-1)^2 exceeds (145/4)(n-1)^2. Hence those two marginal inputs alone cannot prove the clean C36' energy premise. The profiles are not asserted to be subgroup-realizable; this is a route fence, not a counterexample to C36'.
